title: The $14B Hire
sources: Reuters / Fortune / NYT, Jun 12-13 2025: Meta invests $14.3B for 49% of Scale AI (valued $29B+), Wang joins Meta to lead superintelligence lab
Reuters, Jun 14 2025: Google, Scale's largest customer (~$200M planned spend in 2025), plans to cut ties
Bloomberg, Jul 16 2025: Scale AI cuts 14% of staff (~200 full-time)
Forbes 2022: Wang, MIT dropout at 19, co-founded Scale in 2016; youngest self-made billionaire
Reuters, Jun 2025: Meta's Llama 4 got a lackluster reception

lines.say: In June twenty twenty five, Meta paid fourteen billion dollars.
Not for a company. For one twenty eight year old.
lines.show: Not for a company. For one 28-year-old.

lines.say: At nineteen, he dropped out of MIT and started Scale AI.
lines.show: At 19, he dropped out of MIT and started Scale AI.

lines.say: Scale doesn't build AI. It feeds it.
lines.show: Scale doesn't build AI. It feeds it.

lines.say: Its workers label the data that trains AI for Google, OpenAI, and even the US military.
lines.show: Its workers label the data that trains AI for Google, OpenAI, and even the US military.

lines.say: It made him the world's youngest self made billionaire.
lines.show: It made him the world's youngest self-made billionaire.

lines.say: So why did Meta pay so much?
lines.show: So why did Meta pay so much?

lines.say: Because its newest model, Llama four, landed with a shrug, and Zuckerberg was falling behind in the AI race.
lines.show: Because its newest model, Llama 4, landed with a shrug, and Zuckerberg was falling behind in the AI race.

lines.say: So Meta bought forty nine percent of Scale, and hired Wang to run its new superintelligence lab.
lines.show: So Meta bought 49% of Scale, and hired Wang to run its new superintelligence lab.

lines.say: Scale's biggest customer was Google. About two hundred million dollars that year.
lines.show: Scale's biggest customer was Google. About $200 million that year.

lines.say: The day after the deal, reports said Google planned to walk away.
lines.show: The day after the deal, reports said Google planned to walk away.

lines.say: A month later, Scale cut fourteen percent of its staff.
lines.show: A month later, Scale cut 14% of its staff.

lines.say: Meta didn't buy a company. It bought a person. And the company paid the price.
lines.show: Meta didn't buy a company. It bought a person. And the company paid the price.

lines.say: So was it the smartest hire in AI history?
lines.show: So was it the smartest hire in AI history?

lines.say: Or the most expensive one ever?
lines.show: Or the most expensive one ever?
